### The MPG no longer needs merging again after every switch in 1080p

The MSI MPG 274U reads as a different display in 1080p (Dual Mode), so it has to be merged.
Once merged, though, every switch between hosts made the other computer see it as a new
display and ask for the merge again.

Windows reads this display's serial number and macOS does not. A merge made on one computer
reached the other, which recognised it in the background, but the screen compared the
display with its serial number included and found no match. Both sides now compare the same
way. Displays already merged are recognised after updating; there is nothing to redo.

### Diagnostic reports

When switching goes wrong, what each computer sees can now be put into one report and sent,
to help find the cause.

- **You are asked first**: after the tour, MuxSU asks once whether diagnostics may be sent.
  The answer defaults to no and can be changed any time under Displays & Hosts.
- **You can read it before it goes**: under Displays & Hosts → Diagnostics, Review diagnostic
  report shows the whole report, then lets you send it or save it to a file. What is sent is
  exactly what was shown.
- **Automatic reports only when a switch fails**: with consent, a failed switch sends a report
  on its own, at most once every 30 minutes.
- **Paired hosts**: their information is included only when that computer has allowed it too.

A report contains display models and product codes, the input each host uses, display merges,
recent app log lines, and the app version and operating system.

It **never** contains the pairing password, computer or host names, or IP and MAC addresses.
Display serial numbers are replaced by a short code that shows only whether two computers read
the same one.

The app log is now kept on the computer, one file a day for 7 days.

### Other changes

- The Download and install button in the update dialog was grey; it now has the primary
  button colour.

### Compatibility

Pairs with v0.4.0 and needs no setting up again. Older versions do not answer diagnostic
requests, so to include the other computer in a report, update it to v0.4.1 as well.

### Known limitations

- Unmerging does not move back the input settings and notes that were folded into the other
  identity.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed and not yet notarised with an Apple Developer ID, so
  Gatekeeper may ask you to allow it manually.
